controller.comparison: 2*duty-1 >= triangular_carrier(t+5us,50000); lower is NOT upper for t>0

initialization.method: Both MOSFET channels and diodes blocked at t=0; solve DC snubber/load division. Rdown=1/(1/100000+1/3.75); UC0=30*Rdown/(100000+Rdown); iL0=UC0/3.75. L is DC short, so its 10k parallel branch has zero initial current.

topology: Vdc(dc,0); upper channel(dc,mid) and lower channel(mid,0), each in parallel with 100k snubber; L(mid,out) in parallel with 10k; C(out,0) in parallel with 3.75ohm and pulsed current sink(out,0). No source/load or parasitic branch removed.
directions: iL: mid to out; UC: out minus ground; Isrc: source dc terminal into network = -i:Vdc; load sink: out to ground; upper channel dc to mid and lower mid to ground
control_update: At t0 observe initial conditions only. At each t_n>0, solve electrical network using held duty_(n-1) and carrier(t_n), then LP backward Euler using measured UC_n and actual dt, PI new integral with no internal limits, then external Limiter. Updated duty_n acts at subsequent stamps. No extra carrier hold.
pulse_event_semantics: Explicit local SimulationEvent changes scalar current only after left integration; fixed L/C states determine right algebraic solution. Do not use a time-function jump as an unmarked source or a sloping interpolation of the pulse.

reference_solver.note: Global positive scalar AbsTol; no physical/variant/logging-marker edits. SaveTime/SaveState Dataset and existing Scope logging only, with existing Scope point limits off and decimation 1 through SimulationInput; preserve native discrete-state axis separately. Each full run saved before extraction, no synthetic fallback.
